title: Deliver signed target_repo bridge persistence with review evidence
summary_zh: 承接 PR #5450 已驗證的 target_repo bridge 修復，補齊 exact-head evidence 後正式 review/merge；V1 僅保留為 catalog dependency anchor。

contracts.bridge_task_target_repo_required: BridgeTask requires target_repo field and includes it in signed task_spec_hash calculation.
contracts.alias_conflict_rejection_and_normalizati: BridgeTask model validation normalizes identical alias keys without extra model pollution and rejects conflicting target_repo / targetRepo alias values before signed hashing or state mutation.
contracts.canonical_materialization_persistence: Canonical dev-bridge batch materialization persists target_repo in ai-status task state and task state store events.
contracts.readback_immutable_matching: Authoritative readback validates exact immutable target_repo matching between canonical task state and signed task_spec for both pantheon and execute-plans repositories.
contracts.pre_mutation_scope_validation: Batch materialization rejects unknown repository scopes, ambiguous multi-repository values (e.g. 'pantheon+execute-plans'), and conflicting artifact prefixes (e.g. target_repo 'pantheon' with 'execute-plans/...' artifacts) before any canonical state mutation or journal event emission.

required_checks: verify BridgeTask requires target_repo and includes it in task_spec_hash
verify canonical materialization persists target_repo on task state and events
verify readback validates immutable target_repo matching for pantheon and execute-plans
verify unknown, mixed, or artifact-conflicting repository scopes fail before canonical mutation
verify all development bridge and ai_status test suites pass
bind this manifest path (docs/deployment/evidence/supervisor/OPGAP-DEVTOOL-TARGET-REPO-BRIDGE-V2-20260830/evidence.json) in the canonical approve command
